notes.title: Mass Effect Legendary Edition changes Tali's controversial cabin photo
notes.notes: Mass Effect Legendary Edition changes one of the longest-standing issues with the franchise: Tali's face.THERE MAY BE MASS EFFECT SPOILERS AHEAD.Original party member Tali'Zorah is a quarian whose face has been one of the most popular online discussion topics about Mass Effect. Throughout the series, her face is concealed due to her having to wear a suit that protects her from disease.Read more
